entities.summary: Path to Independence, a transformative movement in Jamaica (1944–1962). Emerged from West Indies Federation and Universal adult suffrage and first elections 1944. Catalyzed Independence — August 6, 1962 and Garvey declared first National Hero of Jamaica (posthumously) 1969.
